meta.name: hunt-clickjacking
meta.description: Hunt Clickjacking — missing X-Frame-Options / CSP frame-ancestors lets an attacker embed the target page in an invisible iframe and trick victims into clicking buttons they cannot see (UI redressing). Targets: login flows, money transfers, account settings, OAuth confirmation pages. Confirm by fetching the page, then PROVE it frames in a real browser and a sensitive state-changing action survives the cross-site context (SameSite cookies / framebusting JS can defeat it) — header-absence alone is not a finding.

copy.tagline: 检测并验证点击劫持漏洞
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要检查网页是否可被嵌入iframe实施点击劫持攻击
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to check if a page can be embedded in an iframe for clickjacking attacks

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你检测网页是否存在点击劫持漏洞。它会检查页面是否缺少 X-Frame-Options 或 CSP frame-ancestors 保护头，并指导你通过实际浏览器验证页面能否被嵌入 iframe 并执行敏感操作。
howto.when: 当你需要测试某个网页（尤其是登录、转账、账户设置、OAuth 确认等页面）是否存在点击劫持风险时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查这个转账页面有没有点击劫持漏洞。
say.note: Claude 会分析页面并给出测试步骤。

say.text: 测试一下这个登录页面能否被 iframe 嵌入。
say.note: Claude 会指导你进行实际浏览器验证。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you detect clickjacking vulnerabilities on web pages. It checks for missing X-Frame-Options or CSP frame-ancestors headers and guides you to verify in a real browser whether the page can be iframed and a sensitive action performed.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to test a web page (especially login, money transfer, account settings, OAuth confirmation pages) for clickjacking risks.

say_en.text: Check this transfer page for clickjacking.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the page and provide testing steps.

say_en.text: Test if this login page can be iframed.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through real browser verification.
